facts.fact: Botswana's Ministry of Communications and Innovation held a five-day data governance training and stakeholder engagement on 7-11 September 2026 to support developing the National Data Strategy, which is being drafted with African Union Commission and EU support; the source does not say the strategy or the National Data Policy it follows has been adopted.

facts.fact: Assistant Minister Shawn Ntlhaile said government has completed its draft National Data Policy, which with the National Data Strategy 2027-2032 was being validated at a Gaborone workshop on 25 November 2026 ahead of formal approval.

note: No body named to carry out the policy; chief data officers are only asked of institutions.
